threat_event: CUI drawings are stored and shared outside the FPE on the commercial project platform and in shares
threat_source: Process failure; external users of SYS-C1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 20 sampled USACE folders on SYS-C1 held CUI; subcontractors have access
treatment_plan: Purge and move CUI to the FPE; DLP scan of SYS-C1; training for 11 project teams (group plan GR-06)

threat_event: Constructors cannot show a Conditional Level 2 (C3PAO) status when USACE requires it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-assessment score 74 of 110; non-eligible POA&M items open (for example, 3.12.4 System Security Plan gaps)
treatment_plan: Close non-eligible items and reach at least 88 before the 2027-03-15 C3PAO assessment (voluntary while CMMC Phase 2 is suspended)

threat_event: A compromised commissioning kit pivots into an owner's control system (Hydro or external)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kits not in EDR; cellular routers with remote support tools
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 5.2) at Hydro BES plants; client contracts
treatment_plan: Kit standard: EDR, no remote support tools, routers removed (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: Business email compromise changes a subcontractor's bank account and diverts a progress payment
Ransomware encrypts jobsite trailers and the project platform sync
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 410 trailers with mixed device management
existing_controls: EDR on managed laptops; platform is SaaS

threat_event: Subcontractor accounts on SYS-C1 stay active after the project ends
existing_controls: Expiry dates on new accounts since 2026-03
treatment_plan: Quarterly external account review per project

threat_event: Telematics accounts are taken over and equipment locations exposed
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Constructors security and compliance lead

threat_event: Covered video surveillance equipment is installed on a federal project, triggering a FAR 52.204-25 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Constructors installs cameras and access control at client sites
existing_controls: Approved product list for low-voltage subcontractors
treatment_plan: Pre-install review of every camera and recorder model on federal jobs

threat_event: A lost project laptop exposes FCI and client drawings
treatment_plan: Extend encryption checks to commissioning kits

threat_event: Crew badging lists with driver's license numbers are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lists kept on SYS-C1 for site access
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Florida worked example: Fla. Stat. 501.171)

threat_event: The AI estimating assistant exposes bid pricing or produces a costly estimating error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant drafts quantities and prices from historical bids

threat_event: Constructors staff at Hydro sites follow the 2023 supplement and skip Hydro OT rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplement not re-aligned to 2026 group policy

threat_event: A DFARS cyber incident report is late because no one holds a current medium assurance certificate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One certificate holder; certificate renewal not tracked
treatment_plan: Two certificate holders; renewal tracked in the regulatory calendar

threat_event: Computer vision safety cameras on jobsites raise worker privacy or labor relations concerns
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot at 12 jobsites; footage retained 30 days
existing_controls: Notice to crews; no individual discipline from the model
treatment_plan: Union notice and retention rules before expansion (P10)

threat_event: The FPE is unavailable and federal project work stops
treatment_plan: Document a CUI work pause procedure

threat_event: A Kaspersky or FASCSA covered article is found in project systems and reported late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Software inventory on jobsite devices incomplete
